entity_types: Association or foundation (non-profit legal entities under Civil Code art. 24); optional public-benefit status; registered by the State Registry Agency (PSDA).
cost_time: State fee 990 GEL + 244 GEL (~$270 total, 2025 rates); online filing at PSDA, 3-10 days to certificate.

entity_types: Public associations (Law on Public Associations, replaced by Law No. 70-V of 3 May 2014, amended 2017); registration is state permission, not declaration.
cost_time: Fees unpublished; permit regime - registration with Interior Ministry and government permission; effectively impossible for foreign founders.

entity_types: Public association registered with the Ministry of Justice (Law on Public Associations, art. 21 state registration); foreign participation restricted.
cost_time: Registration fee set by government decree, amount unpublished; Ministry of Justice processing time unpublished; foreign founders face extra authorization.

entity_types: Association (Law 90/053 of 1990) and ONG (Law 99/014 of 22 Dec 1999); ONGs need 'reconnaissance' by Interior Ministry; 2017 civil-society law tightened rules.
cost_time: Fees low (legalization a few thousand FCFA, ~$5); 'reconnaissance' decision time unpublished; 2017 law requires prior government approval, restrictive for foreign founders.

entity_types: Association declared under civil code; ONG status via 'agrement' (administrative act) under the law governing ONGs, which covers national and international ONGs.
cost_time: Declaration fee minimal (~$10-20); 'agrement' grant time unpublished; international ONGs need state authorization before operating.

entity_types: Association under Ordinance 023/PR/2018 of 27 June 2018; international NGO regime under Law 05/2012 of 17 Feb 2012; registration with Interior Ministry.
cost_time: Fees minimal, amounts unpublished; decision time unpublished; INGOs need ministry agreement - foreign founders can only register as INGOs with a local partner.

entity_types: Association declared under the 1901 French law (still in force); legal personality on declaration to the prefecture; ONG status by ministerial decree.
cost_time: Declaration free, small legalization fees (~$5-10); legal personality on filing, processing time unpublished; ONG decree needed for international scope.

entity_types: ASBL (non-profit association) or EUP (public utility establishment) under Law 004/2001 of 20 July 2001; legal personality granted by the Minister.
cost_time: Fees low (~$10-30 for filing and publication); ministerial decision time unpublished; foreign nationals may be founders.

entity_types: Association under Law 35-62 of 10 Dec 1962; declared to the prefecture, legal personality on declaration; ONGs need technical 'agrement'.
cost_time: Declaration fees minimal (~$10); legal personality on filing, processing time unpublished; 'agrement' required for ONG scope.

entity_types: Association under Law 11/1992; NGO regime under Law 1/1999 of 24 Feb 1999 (national ONGs) - registration with Interior Ministry.
cost_time: Fees unpublished; registration time unpublished; restrictive environment, foreign founders face prior-authorization practice.

entity_types: Association by declaration (civil-law system); international NGOs operate under government 'agrement'; FONG-STP is the national NGO federation.
cost_time: Fees minimal, amounts unpublished; 'agrement' time unpublished; foreign founders may register via the declaration procedure.

entity_types: NNGO (national NGO) under RGB (Rwanda Governance Board, est. by Law 56/2016) - certificate of legal personality; INGOs need separate authorization.
cost_time: Registration fee 300,000 RWF (~$25), non-refundable; RGB must decide within 60 days; paid electronically at e-imiryango.rgb.rw.

entity_types: Non-profit association under Law 1/02 of Jan 2017 (framework law replacing decree-law 1/11 of 1992); registration with Interior Ministry.
cost_time: Fees unpublished; decision time unpublished; 2017 framework law tightens state monitoring - effectively difficult for foreign founders.

entity_types: NGO registered with the National Bureau for NGOs under the NGO Act 2016 (categories: indigenous, regional, continental, foreign, international); CBOs registered at district level.
cost_time: Registration fee UGX 100,000 (~$27) indigenous, UGX 520,000 (~$135) foreign org; permit time unpublished; foreign NGOs must register in the 'foreign' category.

entity_types: NGO under the NGO Act 2002, registered at district/regional/national level with the Community Service Registration Board; INGOs via national level.
cost_time: National-level fee TZS 115,000 (~$45); online via nis.jamii.go.tz; processing time unpublished; INGO registration ~USD 267 incl. stamp duty.

entity_types: NGO under the NGO Co-ordination Act 1990 (NGO Board); PBO under the PBO Act 2013 (PBOR) - the more common charity form.
cost_time: NGO fee KES 16,000 domestic (~$120) / KES 30,000 international; PBO registration ~KES 3,000-5,000; processing time unpublished; foreign founders allowed.

entity_types: Association under Law 86-006/AF of 30 May 1986 (art. 9 restricts foreign associations); international NGOs require 'agrement' per Decree 20-101/PR of 31 July 2020.
cost_time: Fees minimal, amounts unpublished; 'agrement' time unpublished; foreign founders must obtain government authorization before operating.

entity_types: ONG under Law 96-030 of 14 Aug 1997 (special regime, Decree 98-711 of 1998); association by declaration - legal personality on declaration.
cost_time: Fees minimal (~$10-20); decision time unpublished; foreign founders can establish ONGs; national scope by declaration, international via authorization.
